in_sanskrit.name: कुन्दन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: कु (Ku, Kun, meaning 'Gold, wealth') + दन (Dan, meaning 'Giver, Donor, Provider') = कुन्दन (Kundan, meaning 'Golden, precious, adorned with gems')

in_hindi.name: कुन्दन
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिंदी में कुन्दन का नाम सोना (Sona, meaning 'Gold') या काजुबारा (Kajubara, meaning 'Jeweler') या मूल्यवान (Moolyavan, meaning 'Valuable, precious') के साथ जुड़ा जाता है।

in_tamil.name: குந்தன
in_tamil.long_meaning: தமிழ் மேலும் குந்தன் (Kundan) ஜோடி (Jodi, meaning 'Gold') எவ்வாறு மொழி (Moi, meaning 'Jewel') எவ்வாறு கிழன்கோளம் (Kizhankolam, meaning 'Adorned with jewels') களவும் அன்வயம் இதற்காக விவரிत மாற்றம் படிக்கப்படுகின்றது.

in_telugu.name: కుందన
in_telugu.long_meaning: తెలుగు మేలు కుందన (Kundan) సోయం (Soyam, meaning 'Gold') యే���� utils జీజేదరి (Jejedari, meaning 'Jeweler') యే���� utils మూళ్ళు (Moolulu, meaning 'Valuable, precious') ఎ���� times జోజేయే���� dosam అదేయి.

in_marathi.name: Kundan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Golden, precious stone
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kundan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kuntala’, meaning ‘golden’ or ‘a precious stone’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often depicted with a crescent moon on his forehead and a Kundan lingam at his base, representing the divine masculine and feminine energies.

in_bengali.name: Kundan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Golden, precious stone
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kundan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kuntala’, meaning ‘golden’ or ‘a precious stone’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often depicted with a crescent moon on his forehead and a Kundan lingam at his base, representing the divine masculine and feminine energies.
